音频反应组

这需要一些工作。我所做的是使用音频反应节点和 Lora 单词触发器的提示调度。使用 Loras 并让音频通过 pw a 和 pw b 输入影响触发词强度。

这不是永久性的，仍在研究更好的解决方案，但目前有效。

要使用常规提示，请将调节开关设置为 true 并绕过音频反应组。

要使用音频反应 Lora 提示，请取消绕过音频反应组，将调节开关设置为 false，将 Lora 强度设置为 1 到 0.80 之间，并将降噪强度设置为 0.20 到 0.40 左右。这将为您提供迄今为止我的测试的最佳结果。

更新了视频上传，将IP适配器转换为平铺IP适配器，降级了ksampler，暂时添加了影响音频的方法。一些细微的改进。

Audio Reactive Group

This took some work. What I did was use the audio reactive nodes and the prompt scheduling with Lora word triggers. Using Loras and letting the audio influence the trigger word strength through the pw a and pw b inputs.

This isn't permanent, still working on a better solution, but it works for now.

To use regular prompts set the conditioning switches to true and bypass the audio reactive group.

To use Audio Reactive Lora prompts, un-bypass the Audio Reactive Group, set the conditioning switches to false, set your lora strength between 1 and .80 and set denoising strength to around .20 to .40. This will give you the best results from my testing so far.

Updated video upload, converted IP adapter to tile IP adapter, downgraded ksampler, added a means of influencing audio for now. Some slight improvements.
